Description: Ethernet switch #1 also powered on remotely.

Press ‘EA ON’ switch and observe EA Rack-1, EA Rack-
2, MMJ AC/DC units, MBJ AC/DC units and CU health
status indication on console desk.

Press ‘SCD ON’ switch and observe SCD processor,
Monitor1 and Monitor2 are powered ON.

Set the key lock in ‘ON’ position for routing DC (24V) to
EA RACK1 unit.
This indicates the status of ES processor health status.
This indicates the status of EA processor health status.

Press ‘JAM INIT’ switch and observe that the internal
LED of the switch glows and the control voltage (24VDC)
is routed to jammer Unit.

Press ‘ES RESET’ button and observe ES and its LRUs
are powered on once again.

Press ‘EA RESET’ button and observe EA and its LRUs
are powered on once again.
